title: History Of Assamese Literature
author: Dr. Sivanath Barman (Ed.)
description: Comprehensive academic volume examining the evolution of Assamese literature, focusing on the substantial linguistic substrate contributed by Southwestern Tai (Khamyang, Ahom, Phake) to medieval vocabulary, grammar, and chronicle prose.
